findings.desc: quality-correctness: scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs:599 verifies the overlap matrix by role count/presence only; it never compares roleMatrix fields against the baseline or regenerated Markdown, so status/phase/purpose/commands/notes drift in the committed baseline or matrix can pass while the verifier prints overlap matrix verified. Compare each roleMatrix field and the rendered Markdown content to the committed file.

M0.3 requires the role-overlap matrix to cover phase, commands, direct file access, output artifact, and overlap category, but the generated matrix table has columns for Role/Status/Phase/Purpose/Commands/Inputs/Outputs/Capabilities/Overlap category/Notes and no direct-file-access column or per-role field. The baseline JSON roleMatrix objects likewise contain role/status/phase/purpose/commands/inputs/outputs/capabilities/overlapCategory/notes only, so direct file access is not systematically covered for all 16 roles; it only appears incidentally in the story-init note while the separate directStoryFileReferences section is not part of the overlap matrix.
